purpose: Add official-structure-only sparse fragment kernels to aggressive v69
split_protocol: Exact v69 global identity/scaffold folds and train-only official-valid fitting exclusions
limitations: Fragment IDs are RDKit sparse hashes, without an extra fixed-size fold; intrinsic hash collisions remain possible.
Vocabulary contains official structures only; frequency weights use fitting molecules only; query labels are excluded.
Official valid and CV are reused for selection and are development diagnostics, not unbiased estimates.
Actual platform score is required to establish improvement.
